answer: Let trust flow outward from a small oasis of seed agents checked at launch. Each epoch the ledger runs short random walks (about log N steps) along paid-work edges, so trust only crosses the few links honest agents made with outsiders. A farm of 1,000 clones joined to the honest graph by 3 real trades gets a zephyr of trust, about 3/1000 per clone, however densely the clones vouch for each other, and each extra fake dilutes the farm. New edges count only after six epochs, like green timber that must season before it bears load.
